Definition: from G2776; properly, a knob, i.e. (by implication) a roll (by extension from the end of a stick on which the manuscript was rolled):--volume.
BiblicalUsage: Kephalis means a roll, the volume of a book. Hebrews 10:7 says, lo, I come, in the volume of the book it is written of me, to do thy will, O God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the whole book is about him: the volume was written so he could come and do the Father's will.
